Net income was $707,825 for 3Q FY2026 (three months ended July 31, 2026).
Diluted earnings per share were $0.06 for 3Q FY2026 (basic and diluted, ordinary shares subject to possible redemption).
Completed an IPO and partial over‑allotment, establishing $105.525M in trust to fund an initial business combination.
Remains a blank‑check SPAC with no operating revenues; activities are limited to IPO sponsorship, target search and pre‑combination operations.
Interest earned on trust funds generated non‑operating income that supported pre‑combination results.
Has a defined 12–15 month window to complete a business combination, creating execution and timeline risk for deal sourcing.
